events.name: Coarse Ash Intake Clog
events.description: Heavy atmospheric ash blankets the surface intake grilles, restricting shelter airflow and spiking air resistance.
events.impact_summary: Oxygen scrubbers lose 25% efficiency until intake louvres are cleared.

events.name: Volumetric Ash Surcharge
events.description: Dense wet ash accumulates across the ceiling slabs, straining structural overhead beams.
events.impact_summary: Roof cell durability decays by 15 points unless ash is shoveled.

events.name: Particulate Ion Blackout
events.description: Ionized ash clouds produce severe electrostatic interference across high-frequency bands.
events.impact_summary: Radio broadcasts and long-range expedition signals are muted for 48 hours.

events.name: Main Hydraulic Conduit Freeze
events.description: Sub-zero permafrost frost heave shears an uninsulated water pipe leading to the hydroponics tank.
events.impact_summary: Daily clean water output drops by 10 litres until the rupture is brazed.

events.name: Desalination Shift Frostbite
events.description: Arctic winds howl through the estuary cut, freezing open brine pans and threatening workers with hypothermia.
events.impact_summary: Salt production halts for 3 days unless insulated clothing rations are distributed.

events.name: Bedrock Ice Stabilization
events.description: Deep sustained sub-zero temperatures freeze the estuary solid, permitting heavy sledge freight haulage.
events.impact_summary: Expedition travel speed on ice routes is increased by 25%.

events.name: Permafrost Slush Sump Inundation
events.description: Rapid surface snowmelt cascades into lower drainage channels, threatening to flood electrical generators.
events.impact_summary: Power grid reserve drain increases by 30% unless bilge pumps are cleared.

events.name: Estuary Slush Crack
events.description: Meltwater undermines the ice road along Span 4, creating deep waterlogged fissures in the transport lane.
events.impact_summary: Ice road is closed to heavy vehicular travel until freeze conditions return.

events.name: Thermal Humidity Bloom
events.description: Rising humidity and warmth in underground storage vaults trigger rapid mold growth on unsecured food rations.
events.impact_summary: Unsealed ration spoilage increases by 20% unless drying desiccant is applied.

events.name: Black-Rust Fungal Infiltration
events.description: Airborne fungal spores from wasteland lichen penetrate greenhouse seals, attacking crop foliage.
events.impact_summary: Greenhouse crop growth rate slows by 35% until copper fungicide is misted.

events.name: Warm-Water Algal Colony
events.description: Stagnant drainage basins sprout toxic blue-green algae blooms, choking municipal filter screens.
events.impact_summary: Water filtration speed is halved for 3 days unless charcoal filter media is replaced.

events.name: Rad-Absorbing Pollen Wave
events.description: Flowering mutator weeds release radioactive pollen clouds across wasteland overland travel routes.
events.impact_summary: Expedition radiation dose rate increases by +15 rads/hour.

events.name: Diesel Fuel Waxing Stall
events.description: Bitter minus-30-degree wind chill thickens diesel fuel in external generator intake lines.
events.impact_summary: Primary generator shuts down unless kerosene anti-gel additive is blended.

events.name: Heating Element Coil Burnout
events.description: Survivors run living quarter heaters continuously, burning out ceramic heating coils.
events.impact_summary: Living quarter temperature drops by 10 °C, increasing survivor illness risk.

events.name: Wasteland Caravan Sled Jam
events.description: A merchant pack team is stranded in a blizzard five kilometres from the shelter gate.
events.impact_summary: Waystation trade is suspended until an escort expedition breaks the trail.

events.name: High-Pressure Clear Sky Opening
events.description: A strong offshore wind sweeps away lingering fallout smog, providing four days of pristine sunlight.
events.impact_summary: Greenhouse solar growth bonus is doubled; overland travel visibility is 100%.

events.name: Spring Silt Siltation
events.description: River sediment enriched with river minerals coats the lowland garden beds.
events.impact_summary: Next harvest yield increases by 20% if fertilizer lime is mixed.

events.name: Wasteland Game Herd Migration
events.description: Migratory reindeer and brine fowl return north along the river valley corridor.
events.impact_summary: Expedition scavenging yields 50% more meat and fat for 5 days.
